abilities.name: Burning Ward
abilities.rawDescription:
Odd-numbered Rounds: 25% chance to afflict Stagger on 1 Enemy in any lane for 2 rounds. Rounds 2, 5, and 8: deal Fire Damage to 1 Enemy in any lane, prioritizing targets not afflicted with Burn (Damage Rate: +115%); additionally, there is a 50% chance to afflict the target with Burn for 2 rounds.

At 6+ Stars, increase Burning Ward's odd-round Stagger chance to 38%. Each Round: deal Fire Damage to all Enemies afflicted with a Control effect (Damage Rate: +20%). Control effects include Stun, Stagger, Overwhelm, and Confusion.

Fire Damage is increased by the attacker's Intelligence and mitigated by the target's Initiative. Burn deals Fire Damage each round for 2 rounds (Damage Rate: +20%). Stagger prevents the target from using Attack Modifier Commands or launching Basic Attacks on its turn.

abilities.name: Hunter's Wrath
abilities.rawDescription: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard, increase Tairax Fire Damage Dealt by +16%. Increase Strength and Initiative by +20 of the Ally deployed in the Right Flank.

abilities.name: Whisper of Ash
abilities.rawDescription:
Start of Round 1: reduce Strength and Initiative of 1 Enemy in the same lane by -16%, enhanced by Tairax Intelligence, for 5 rounds. Start of Round 6: increase Tairax Intelligence and Initiative by +16% for 5 rounds.

Habit Level progression for both groups (1–5): 16%, 19.2%, 22.4%, 27.2%, 32%; enemy values are negative and self values are positive.
Habit Power (Levels 1–5): 340, 740, 1200, 1800, 2500.

abilities.name: Sunder
abilities.rawDescription:
Start of Each Round: increase Damage Received by +7.5% of all Enemies afflicted with a Control effect until the end of the round. Control effects include Stun, Stagger, Overwhelm, and Confusion.

Habit Level progression (1–5): +7.5%, +9%, +10.5%, +12.75%, +15%.
Habit Power (Levels 1–5): 340, 740, 1200, 1800, 2500.

abilities.name: Gleamstrike
abilities.rawDescription:
Burning Ward gains: Odd-numbered Rounds, increase the chance to afflict Stagger to 38%. Each Round, deal Fire Damage to all Enemies afflicted with a Control effect (Damage Rate: +20%). Control effects include Stun, Stagger, Overwhelm, and Confusion.

The summary displays a 38% Stagger chance. Stagger Chance progression (Habit Levels 1–5): 37.5%, 40%, 42.5%, 46.25%, 50%. Fire Damage Rate progression: 20%, 24%, 28%, 34%, 40%.
Habit Power (Levels 1–5): 340, 740, 1200, 1800, 2500.

abilities.name: Gift of Fire
abilities.rawDescription:
Start of Each Round: for each Enemy afflicted with Burn, 18% chance to apply Resistance (-15%) to 1 Ally in any lane for 2 rounds, prioritizing targets not already affected by Resistance. Resistance reduces the target's Damage Received.

The summary displays an 18% chance. Resistance Chance progression (Habit Levels 1–5): 17.5%, 21%, 24.5%, 29.75%, 35%.
Habit Power (Levels 1–5): 340, 740, 1200, 1800, 2500.

abilities.name: Moonlit Hunt
abilities.rawDescription:
Start of Round 1: grant Tairax Evade for 5 rounds. Evade causes each instance of damage against the target to have a chance to be ignored. Start of Round 6: increase Tairax Fire Damage Dealt by +12% for 5 rounds.

Evade Rate progression (Habit Levels 1–5): 5%, 6.5%, 8%, 10%, 12.5%. Fire Damage Dealt progression: 12%, 15.6%, 19.2%, 24%, 30%.
Habit Power (Levels 1–5): 340, 790, 1400, 2100, 3100.
